sources.title: shaffhausenquant/OpenThinker-7B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: OpenThinker-7B This model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on the OpenThoughts-114k dataset dataset. The dataset is derived by distilling DeepSeek-R1 using the data pipeline available on github. More info about the dataset can be found on the dataset card at OpenThoughts-114k dataset.

sources.title: OpenThinker-7B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview OpenThinker-7B is a reasoning-focused language model built by open-thoughts through fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on the OpenThoughts-114k dataset, which was created by distilling DeepSeek-R1.
